Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Confirmed via `get_service_status` that v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and via `list_deployments` that the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy; v2.3.1 was unhealthy).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created INC-0001 ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the issue and the rollback. (The first call timed out, but the incident was created successfully; I verified it via `list_incidents`.)
3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — The first rollback attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried. The second attempt completed successfully, rolling out v2.3.0 to all regions.

**Final state:** checkout-api is on **v2.3.0** in all three production regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.002. Incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
